description: This file defines interfaces, classes, enums, and structures related to the 3GPP RRC (Radio Resource Control) UE (User Equipment) handling in a 5G/NR context. It includes declarations for managing UE states, control, security, reconfiguration, measurement, and context updates, as well as interactions with lower layers and other network components.

classes.name: rrc_ue_controller
classes.description: Abstract interface for controlling UE-related operations, including stopping transactions.

classes.name: rrc_ul_pdu_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling uplink PDUs on logical channels.

classes.name: rrc_ngap_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling NGAP messages related to UE.

classes.name: rrc_ue_setup_proc_notifier

classes.name: srb_creation_message

classes.name: rrc_ue_reconfiguration_proc_notifier

classes.name: rrc_ue_msg4_proc_notifier

classes.name: rrc_ue_ngap_notifier
classes.description: Interface for NGAP message notifications.
